actors.name: Nurse Karolina
actors.private_context: Karolina wants someone to take her Sunday night shift. She has posted a request in the ward's swap channel. She will not be available to respond further until after the cutoff.

actors.name: Ward colleagues (collective)
actors.private_context: Each colleague sees the swap channel and may consider taking the shift based on their own preferences and availability. No colleague has a prior commitment to take this shift.

shared_context: The ward has a swap channel where shift requests are posted. The rota locks on Friday at 15:00. Karolina's post is visible to all colleagues in the channel. The shift is for Sunday night.

starting_events.description: Karolina posts a message in the ward's swap channel asking someone to take her Sunday night shift.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that a colleague claimed the shift (e.g., by posting a reply or updating the rota) before 2026-08-14T15:00:00+02:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
